messages:
maria: Hey @kevin / @jess — marketing is finalizing the launch blog and we need a compact, reproducible bench pack for the press deck. Can eng/runtime run a focused rerun that captures: p50/p95/p99 latency, tail CPU/GPU utilization, and embedding throughput for the quantized variants?
kevin: Sure. Which models + quantization profiles do you want included?
jess: Also need warm/cold-start slices (first request after idle, and steady-state), plus a `git sha` and job id in the artifact metadata.
maria: Thanks. Priority list: 1) llama-2-13b quantized int8 2) vicuna-13b q4_0 3) openchat-7b baseline float. For each: include 8-token and 2048-token contexts where applicable. We want coldstart (0->1 request after 15m idle) and a 10k-sample steady-state run.
kevin: Got it. Do we have the payloads packaged? We need representative prompt mix: short chat, long completion, code snippet, and embed requests.
oliver: I uploaded a candidate payload pack here: s3://redwood-marketing/benchpacks/launch-2026-candidate.json (contains 3k samples) — it's annotated with label fields for slice tagging.
maria: Perfect. Can you also include the small sample sub-pack for the press (50 hand-picked samples) that show qualitative outputs? We might quote a couple of outputs in the blog.
jess: For the quantitative deck we shouldn't warm enough to mask cold-start. Suggest warmup=0 for coldstart measurement, and warmup=500 requests for steady-state. Also capture token-level timing per-request.
kevin: Implementation plan: we'll run two job types per model/variant — `coldstart-smoke` and `throughput-sweep`. I'll schedule on dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbors. Job names will include `mktg/launch/bench/<model>/<quant>/<ts>`.
kevin: Example command (will run under run_bench.sh):
```
./run_bench.sh --model vicuna-13b --quant q4_0 --payload s3://redwood-marketing/benchpacks/launch-2026-candidate.json --warmup 0 --duration 600 --tag marketing-launch-2026
```
kevin: We'll push artifacts (logs, perf histograms, per-slice CSVs) to s3://redwood-marketing/bench-results/launch-2026/<job-id>/ and include `metadata.json` with git sha and runtime config.
maria: Timeline? We need cleaned artifacts and a short summary (p50/p95/p99 + embed throughput) by EOD Friday so the comms team can draft slides.
jess: Friday EOD is tight but doable if we lock the payloads now and avoid additional models. Recommend we freeze on the three variants maria listed.
kevin: Acknowledged. I'll kick off an initial smoke run for the three variants now and can follow with the longer 10k steady-state runs overnight.
runtime-ci-bot: Scheduled job mktg-launch-1768004321-vicuna-q4_0 started on pool-dedicated-3 (job id 2b7a9f).
oliver: Quick note — please include the seed & RNG settings in metadata; the candidate pack has a deterministic ordering but I added an explicit `random_seed: 42`.
kevin: Thanks — will include seed. Also adding a short README with repro steps for the PR.
maria: Amazing, thank you. If you hit any blockers ping #eng-runtime and cc me. Can you post the artifact links in this thread when done? :thumbsup:
kevin: Will do. First smoke finishes in ~10m, full steady-state runs ~6-8h.
kevin: Posting initial smoke artifacts: s3://redwood-marketing/bench-results/launch-2026/2b7a9f/smoke-summary.json (includes p50/p95/p99 and per-slice breakdown).
jess: Looks good from a quick skim. The vicuna q4_0 tail is higher than expected on coldstart — can you capture per-request GPU power logs for the tail window?
kevin: Noted — enabling power logging for the next run.
maria: If the tail variance persists, we may switch the example on the slide to llama-2-13b int8. Keep us posted.
kevin: Will rerun and update links.
